name: Arsenal Chaplain (Warpriest Archetype)
body:
Warpriests are a vehicle of battle and combat in the name of their deity or faith. Arsenal chaplains take this duty a step further and focus their time and power on combat and skill at arms. They rely on the blessings the deity gives to aid their self-trained martial skill than drawing upon their prayers.

Blessings of War: An arsenal chaplain is dedicated to war, even if their deity or faith is not typically one associated with open combat. The warpriest gains access to the war domain even if their deity does not typically have access to that domain. Additionally, the blessings at 1st, 5th, 9th, 13th and 17th levels must be chosen from the war domain. This ability modifies blessing but does not preclude archetypes that replace those blessing choice levels.

Blessed Combat: An arsenal chaplain gains extra blessings at 4th, 10th and 16th levels that may be chosen from any domain they have access to.

Reduced Spellcasting: An arsenal chaplain casts spells as a paladin of their legendary warpriest level, however they still have the reduced spell-list of the legendary warpriest. They gain their spellcasting caster level and their first complement of spells starting at 4th level. This ability modifies spellcasting.

Martial Focus: An arsenal chaplain gains a base attack bonus equal to their class level, however, they lose the ability to heal themselves or allies or damage foes by touch or aura using fervor. Additionally, your hit dice are increased to d10s.

Demagogue of War (Su)

At 20th level, if you choose the war domain as your avatar of war ability, instead of the increase to your attack bonus, you gain the ability to add your Wisdom bonus to weapon attack rolls once per round. This modifies avatar of war but does not preclude another archetype that replaces or modifies avatar of war.
